key_insight: PDE foundation models pretrained on fluid-like data struggle when transferred to extreme-loading material dynamics with discontinuities (shocks, evolving interfaces, fractures), but systematic benchmarking reveals specific failure modes and guidance for improving OOD transfer.
problem_solved: Evaluates how well fluid-centric PDE foundation models generalize to two discontinuity-dominated, out-of-distribution material-dynamics regimes (perturbed layered interface — PLI — and dynamic fracture — FRAC) and frames the downstream task as terminal-state prediction to quantify transfer performance.
method: Assemble two challenging downstream regimes (PLI and FRAC) that produce highly non-smooth fields dominated by shocks, interfaces, and fractures.
Transfer pretrained PDE foundation models to these regimes and evaluate terminal-state prediction accuracy, robustness, and failure modes versus ground truth simulations.
Analyze errors spatially and temporally to identify where and why fluid-trained models break down and suggest targeted remedies (data, loss, or architecture changes).
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners with a clearbenchmark and diagnostic roadmap showing the limits of fluid-trained PDE models on extreme material dynamics, informing better pretraining, data augmentation, and model design for non-smooth physics.
visual_elements: Side-by-side schematic of the two regimes (PLI: layered interface with shock; FRAC: dynamic fracture propagation) to show physical differences
Comparison panel: ground-truth vs model-predicted terminal states with overlaid error heatmaps highlighting localized prediction failures
Bar/line chart quantifying metrics (e.g., terminal-state RMSE, structural error rates) across models and regimes to show transfer degradation
Flow diagram of transfer workflow: pretrained PDE model → fine-tuning/evaluation on PLI and FRAC → diagnostic analysis and suggested fixes
paper_title: Out-of-distribution transfer of PDE foundation models to material dynamics under extreme loading
paper_authors: Mahindra Rautela, Alexander Most, Siddharth Mansingh, Aleksandra Pachalieva, Bradley Love
